items.name: Befrena launch ramp (U.S. clinics)
items.claim: Elanco reported Befrena had shipped to nearly 1,400 U.S. clinics, with customer demand 2x above expectations and capacity being ramped weekly.
items.source_excerpt: Befrena™ shipped to nearly 1,400 U.S. clinics to date; ramping capacity to meet high customer demand 2x above expectations, with weekly increases in supply

items.name: Zenrelia and Credelio Quattro innovation launches
items.claim: Elanco named Zenrelia, its newest blockbuster, as the single largest contributor to company growth in the quarter, followed by Credelio Quattro.
items.source_excerpt: Zenrelia — our newest blockbuster — was the single largest contributor to global Elanco growth, closely followed by Credelio Quattro.

items.name: Next-wave innovation pipeline (10+ blockbuster-potential projects)
items.claim: Elanco has 10+ major innovation projects with blockbuster potential in development and expects approvals for 5-6 major differentiated assets from this pipeline between 2026 and 2031.
items.source_excerpt: Elanco has 10+ major innovation projects with blockbuster potential in development , expecting approvals for 5-6 major differentiated assets from this pipeline between 2026 and 2031.

items.name: Pipeline peak sales value
items.claim: Elanco said the differentiated pipeline assets represent an unprobabilized potential peak sales value of more than $2 billion.
items.source_excerpt: These differentiated pipeline assets represent an unprobabilized potential peak sales value of more than $2 billion

items.name: Immuno-therapeutic pet blockbuster candidate (USDA accelerated conditional approval pathway)
items.claim: USDA granted an accelerated pathway for conditional approval of a novel immuno-therapeutic with first-in-class major pet blockbuster potential, expected in the next 2-3 years.
items.source_excerpt: The U.S. Department of Agriculture (USDA) has granted an accelerated pathway for conditional approval of a novel immuno-therapeutic that has the potential to be a first-in-class major pet health blockbuster, expected in the next 2-3 years.

items.name: 2026 innovation revenue target
items.claim: Elanco raised its expected 2026 innovation revenue contribution from approximately $1.1 billion to $1.15 billion.
items.source_excerpt: Expected innovation revenue contribution of approximately $1.1 billion in 2026 -- now raised to $1.15 billion

items.name: Big 6 delivered and Befrena USDA approval
items.claim: Elanco exceeded its innovation revenue target at $892 million and delivered all Big 6 blockbuster potential products by the end of 2025 with Befrena approval in Q4 2025.
items.source_excerpt: Exceeded innovation revenue target at $892 million; delivered all 'Big 6' blockbuster potential products by the end of 2025 with Befrena approval in Q4 2025
